title: Hockey Nation: Sports History and Canadian Identity
description: Examines the history of Canada through the history of sport from pre-industrial times to the late 20th century. Includes attention to Aboriginal games, lacrosse, ice hockey, baseball, basketball, football and track and field.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of HSTR 300B, HIST 348A, HIST 358 (if taken as section A04 in Sep-Dec 2012).
May not be counted toward upper-level requirements in Honours, Major, or General and Minor Programs in History.
